abi.note: The syscall instruction destroys RCX and R11, which is why the fourth argument travels in R10 rather than RCX as it would in a normal function call.

source: Numbers taken from the kernel's asm/unistd_64.h. Entries marked detailed=false carry the name and number only; their arguments are not modelled.

syscalls.name: read
syscalls.summary: Read bytes from a file descriptor into a buffer.
syscalls.signature: ssize_t read(int fd, void *buf, size_t count)

args.name: count
args.description: maximum number of bytes to read

syscalls.returns: Number of bytes read, 0 at end of file, or a negative errno.
errors: -EBADF: fd is not a valid open descriptor
-EFAULT: buf points outside the accessible address space
-EINTR: interrupted by a signal before any data was read
-EAGAIN: the descriptor is non-blocking and no data was ready
syscalls.example:
mov     rax, 0              ; read
    mov     rdi, 0              ; stdin
    lea     rsi, [rel buffer]
    mov     rdx, 64
    syscall

syscalls.name: write
syscalls.summary: Write bytes from a buffer to a file descriptor.
syscalls.signature: ssize_t write(int fd, const void *buf, size_t count)
syscalls.returns: Number of bytes written, or a negative errno.
errors: -EBADF: fd is not a valid open descriptor
-EFAULT: buf points outside the accessible address space
-EPIPE: the reading end of the pipe or socket is closed
-ENOSPC: the device holding the file has no room left
syscalls.example:
mov     rax, 1              ; write
    mov     rdi, 1              ; stdout
    lea     rsi, [rel message]
    mov     rdx, message_len
    syscall

syscalls.name: open
syscalls.summary: Open a file, returning a file descriptor.
syscalls.signature: int open(const char *pathname, int flags, mode_t mode)

args.name: flags
args.description: O_RDONLY 0, O_WRONLY 1, O_RDWR 2, bitwise-ORed with O_CREAT 0o100, O_TRUNC 0o1000, O_APPEND 0o2000

args.name: mode
args.description: permission bits, used only when O_CREAT is set

syscalls.returns: A new file descriptor, or a negative errno.
errors: -ENOENT: the file does not exist and O_CREAT was not set
-EACCES: the requested access is not permitted
-EISDIR: the path is a directory opened for writing
-EMFILE: the process has too many open files
syscalls.example:
mov     rax, 2              ; open
    lea     rdi, [rel path]
    mov     rsi, 0              ; O_RDONLY
    xor     edx, edx
    syscall

syscalls.name: close
syscalls.summary: Close a file descriptor.
syscalls.returns: 0 on success, or a negative errno.
errors: -EBADF: fd is not a valid open descriptor
syscalls.example:
mov     rax, 3              ; close
    mov     rdi, rbx            ; the descriptor
    syscall

syscalls.name: mmap
syscalls.summary: Map files or anonymous memory into the address space.
syscalls.signature: void *mmap(void *addr, size_t length, int prot, int flags, int fd, off_t offset)

args.name: addr
args.description: preferred address, or 0 to let the kernel choose

args.name: fd
args.description: descriptor to map, or -1 for anonymous memory

args.name: offset
args.description: offset within the file, a multiple of the page size

syscalls.returns: The address of the mapping, or a negative errno.
errors: -ENOMEM: no memory is available or the map count was exceeded
-EINVAL: length is zero, or addr or offset is misaligned
-EACCES: the descriptor does not permit the requested protection
syscalls.example:
mov     rax, 9              ; mmap
    xor     edi, edi            ; let the kernel choose
    mov     rsi, 4096
    mov     rdx, 3              ; PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE
    mov     r10, 0x22           ; MAP_PRIVATE|MAP_ANONYMOUS
    mov     r8, -1
    xor     r9d, r9d
    syscall
